content.text:
I reviewed every input file, all ten draft sections, the numeral ledger, and all five figure briefs, and built a full source ledger tracing each claim limitation, numbered part, and figure geometry statement back to the disclosure.

**Trace highlights**

- **Claims 1–17**: every limitation maps to an affirmative disclosure sentence — three carriages in radial guides with pivoting concave pads ("Three radial jaw carriages… carries a pivoting concave jaw pad"), segmented ring with one segment per half, complementary hinge-end and latch-end drive faces coupling on closure, follower-in-oblique-slot synchronization, wedge on latch driving a ring drive face through a limited stroke, carriage springs, the two latch positions, the force-limiting spring stack, indicator pin against the latch-housing fixed edge, and the mounting boss outside the annular guide (dependent claims 8/13/17). The installed-assembly class (claim 11) rests on the disclosed clamp-on-pipe state; the method claims track the disclosed install/remove sequence.
- **Numerals 10–66**: 28 entries, each used once in the description with a single meaning, and the union of the five figure numeral lists equals the ledger exactly — no orphan and no unused numeral.
- **Figure geometry**: the substantive statements I checked hardest are all compelled by source. Slot inclination "in the same rotational sense" follows from "synchronized inward travel of all three jaw carriages" under one rotation; the ring drive face "near the right junction, which is the latch end" follows from the latch-carried wedge bearing on the ring; the cam-ring band "set toward the outer boundary" and the boss "radially outboard of the channel" follow from "a mounting boss outside the annular guide"; pad-not-carriage pipe contact follows from "a pivoting concave jaw pad that bears on a pipe." The wedge is drawn as a plain block with no taper or angle asserted, end-face outlines are left schematic, no counts of spring elements, dimensions, or materials appear.
- **Convention containment**: the "shown schematically" language and the depiction-convention notes stay inside the figure briefs; neither the Brief Description nor the description contains any "by way of example" or "any closed outline" statement added to justify a renderer choice.
- **Consistency**: hinge-left / latch-right orientation is consistent across FIGS. 1–4 (including the FIG. 4 handle direction under the stated re-orientation); segment 32/44/48 sit with the upper half 12 and 34/46/50 with the lower half 14; no section lines are used; no drafting note, placeholder, open question, or unresolved alternative remains. The drafting agent's stray "self-adhering layer with a microsuction surface" statement in the conversation does not appear anywhere in the draft.

input.summary: Full source-fidelity preflight completed against input/disclosure.md as sole invention authority, with input/brief.md used only for title, applicant/inventor, absence of priority claim, and the "Not applicable" government-support statement. I traced every limitation of all seventeen claims (independent claims 1, 11, 14 and dependent claims 2-10, 12-13, 15-17), all twenty-eight reference numerals in draft/numerals.md, every numbered part and structural, positional, connective and operational statement in the field, summary, detailed description, brief description of drawings and abstract, and every geometry statement in figure briefs FIG-1 through FIG-5, to exact affirmative inventor passages. Each of the following traced to disclosure text: two semicircular frame halves with hinge at one end and releasable latch at the other; three radial jaw carriages sliding in radial guides; pivoting concave jaw pads bearing without a tool-specific pipe diameter; segmented cam ring retained in an annular guide with one segment carried by each frame half; complementary drive faces at the hinge and latch ends coupling the segments on closure; a follower per carriage received in a respective oblique slot; wedge driving a ring drive face and rotating the coupled ring through a limited stroke; synchronized equal inward travel; carriage springs biasing outward and retracting the jaws on release; first holding position and second over-center position; force-limiting spring stack in the drive path between latch handle and wedge absorbing travel after all pads contact; visible indicator pin moving relative to a fixed edge of the latch housing at a predetermined compression range and not measuring diameter; the mounting boss outside the annular guide that does not participate in synchronization; and the install and remove sequences including segment separation with their own halves. The claims and the description use the same relationships and terminology (ring drive face is kept distinct from the hinge-end and latch-end segment drive faces), each numeral designates exactly one part, no numeral is unused or orphaned, and the union of the five figure numeral lists equals the ledger exactly. Functional-surface geometry was examined under the stricter standard: slot inclination sense, the circumferential position of the ring drive face at the latch end, the radial seat of the cam-ring band and the follower at the carriage outer end, the boss radially outboard of the channel, the abutting matching end faces at the junctions, and pad-rather-than-carriage pipe contact are each compelled by an affirmative disclosure passage rather than invented; no taper, angle, depth, runout, proportion, count of spring elements, dimension or material is asserted anywhere, and the wedge and end faces are left as generic outlines. The schematic depiction conventions remain confined to the figure briefs; neither the brief description of drawings nor the description contains any "by way of example", "any closed outline", or similar broadening statement added to justify a renderer choice. Cross-figure consistency holds (hinge at the left break and latch at the right break in FIGS. 1-3, handle direction in FIG. 4 consistent with the stated re-orientation of FIG. 1, segments 32/44/48 with upper half 12 and 34/46/50 with lower half 14, three slots matching the three carriage positions), there are no named section lines requiring repeated designations, and no drafting note, placeholder, open question, instruction, unresolved alternative or internal comment remains in any section. The drafting agent's stray reference in conversation.md to a "self-adhering layer with a microsuction surface" is agent prose, not inventor support, and correctly appears nowhere in the draft. Background prior-art characterizations were not treated as requiring inventor support and are left for the later citation review. No unsupported technical assertion and no internal inconsistency was verified, so the findings array is empty.
